title: Unauthenticated access to any collection is denied
steps: 1. Attempt any read/write to Firestore without authentication

title: Creating a transaction with own user_id is allowed
steps: 1. Create a transaction with user_id = own uid

title: Creating a transaction with another user's user_id is denied
steps: 1. Create a transaction with user_id = user B's uid

title: Reading updating and deleting own transaction is allowed
steps: 1. Read/update/delete a transaction owned by self

title: Reading updating and deleting another user's transaction is denied
steps: 1. Read/update/delete a transaction owned by another user

title: Reassigning a transaction's user_id to another user is denied
steps: 1. Attempt to change a transaction's user_id to another user via update

title: Own low_confidence_logs create read and delete are allowed
steps: 1. Create/read/delete a low_confidence_logs document owned by self

title: Updating an own low_confidence_logs document is denied
steps: 1. Attempt to update (not create/delete) an own low_confidence_logs document

title: Another user's low_confidence_logs are fully denied
steps: 1. Attempt to create-on-behalf-of/read/delete another user's low_confidence_logs

title: Only the owning uid may read or write their user profile
preconditions: Authenticated as user A, profile for user B exists
steps: 1. Read/write own users/{uid} profile 2. Attempt to read/write another user's profile
expected_result: Own profile allowed; another user's profile denied

title: User profile is created on first login and updated on subsequent logins
preconditions: Signing in for the first time then again
steps: 1. Sign in for the first time 2. Sign in again on a subsequent login
expected_result: Profile (email, name, photo, last_login) is created then updated

title: Undefined collections are denied even for authenticated users
steps: 1. Attempt to read/write a document in an undefined collection
